fields.label: Creator

fields.label: Description
fields.value: This inventory is number 5 of 6 lists of unscanned files of negatives in the Lane Brothers Commercial Photographers Photographic Collection, Corporate Bodies series. It was created to optimize searching the contents of the collection in Georgia State University Library's Digital Collections. Located in Atlanta, Georgia, Lane Brothers Commercial Photographers existed from the 1930s until about 1980. The collection consists of about 258,100 acetate negatives, 1920-1976 [bulk 1939-1975], housed in 43,486 envelopes organized into 6 series.
